value.produces: freebsd411.qcow2 (FreeBSD 4.11-RELEASE i386 full install from disc1-kde: base + XFree86 4.3.0 + KDE 3.3.2; KDE session auto-started on the console)

value.kbd_note: KDE 3.3.2 desktop; a Konsole holds the keyboard. Type into the Konsole.
value.note: no audio device; ABSOLUTE pointer via x11warp into the guest XFree86 4.3 server (loopback SLIRP forward 6078->6000), buttons + keys over D-Bus PS/2

labctl.notes: no exec channel: drive via QMP keys and read the framebuffer. Pointer MOTION is absolute through the guest X server (SH_INPUT_BACKEND=x11warp on SH_X11WARP_DISPLAY=127.0.0.1:78; the launcher publishes a loopback SLIRP forward 6078->10.0.2.15:6000 and the golden carries xhost +10.0.2.2). Buttons and keys ride the PS/2 path over D-Bus. SINGLE INJECTOR: nothing else may move this pointer. disk.qcow2 is the only block device and carries the golden vmstate under /opt/qemu-beos.

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# freebsd411 (VMID 178) — FreeBSD 4.11-RELEASE (Jan 2005, the last 4.x), KDE 3.3.2 on XFree86 4.3.0
#   (cirrus driver, 1024x768x16). VERBATIM launcher, same device set as netbsd14: one IDE disk
#   carrying the golden vmstate, ne2k_pci SLIRP with the loopback X forward 6078->6000 for the
#   x11warp absolute pointer (display :78); keys + buttons ride the PS/2 path.

launcherParity.reason: pc-i440fx-11.0 under KVM with -vga std (XFree86 4.4.0 vesa, 1024x768x16), one SCSI disk on an lsi53c895a (FreeBSD sym, real DMA -- 4.11's ata driver gets no bus-master DMA on QEMU's PIIX3 and PIO under KVM is ~150 KB/s) carrying the golden vmstate, ne2k_pci on SLIRP with the loopback X forward 6078->6000 for x11warp; no audio device

qemuBuild.base: QEMU 11.0.2 (the same version as the host pve-qemu-kvm 11.0.2-1, so machine type pc-i440fx-11.0 is unchanged)
qemuBuild.note: Same installed build as beos (/opt/qemu-beos); see beos.json for provenance.

museum.lineage: 386BSD → FreeBSD 1.0 (1993) → 2.x → 3.x → 4.0 → 4.11 (2005, the last of the 4.x line) → 5/6 → FreeBSD 15
museum.blurb: FreeBSD 4.11, January 2005: the last release of the 4.x line — the FreeBSD that ran Yahoo!, Hotmail and a generation of ISPs — here with the full KDE 3.3.2 desktop from the release CD, on the i386 it was built for.
museum.notes: Live streamhost station. Boots straight into a root KDE 3.3.2 session on XFree86 4.3.0 (cirrus driver on the emulated Cirrus, 1024x768x16): Kicker panel, K menu, a Konsole already open, with Konqueror, Kate, KCalc and kdegames a click away. The pointer is absolute because the daemon warps the guest X server itself (x11warp over a loopback SLIRP forward) while clicks and keys ride the PS/2 path. disk.qcow2 is the single block device and carries the golden vmstate.

reset.fixture: FreeBSD 4.11 KDE 3.3.2 desktop (XFree86 4.4.0 vesa on -vga std, 1024x768x16): Kicker panel with the K menu, a Konsole holding a root shell; the golden carries xhost +10.0.2.2 so the x11warp pointer works on every restore.
